NEGATIVE_CACHE_TTL_DAYS.description: Days to keep 'not-relevant' verdict cache rows before they expire. Hard-hit rows are audit-only and never expire.

CODE_SCAN_VERDICT_CACHE_TTL_DAYS.description: Days to keep code-scan LLM verdict cache rows before they are re-judged. Content or version changes already invalidate the cache key; the TTL only forces long-unchanged files to be re-judged against model drift (ADR-054).
